exposure: serial cervical length measurements after cerclage
trajectory patterns of cervical length change
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy and a history of cervical insufficiency who underwent prophylactic transvaginal cerclage.
finding: Serial sonographic cervical length measurements after prophylactic cerclage are valuable in predicting preterm birth, with persistent cervical shortening, an average shortening rate >=0.24 cm/week, and cervical length <=1.1 cm significantly associated with spontaneous preterm birth.
